exposure: All or some groups of PTB
All groups of PTB and ETB
outcome: Incidence of preterm birth (PTB) and early term birth (ETB)
Risk factors for PTB and ETB
Feto-maternal outcomes of PTB and ETB
Death of neonate in labor room (LR)/operation theatre (OT)
finding: Advanced maternal age, pre-gestational diabetes mellitus, assisted pregnancies, and preterm history were independent predictors of both PTB and ETB, whereas chromosomal and congenital abnormalities were found to be independent predictors of PTB but not ETB.
mod_finding: All groups of PTB and ETB were significantly associated with caesarean delivery.
